how_to_apply: Applications are accepted from the date of publication of the advertisement until 05:00 PM on 3 December 2026, only by registered post, and must be received at the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Baghpat by then. No application will be considered or accepted after 05:00 PM on 3 December 2026.
At the top of the application, write the name of the post applied for and the name of the programme (for example SNCU, NUHM or CHC NCD Clinic).
Below it, give your name, husband's/father's name, date of birth, gender, mobile number and residential address.

Give all educational qualifications with year of passing/university, subject, maximum marks, marks obtained and percentage, along with your UP Medical Council registration, caste and experience details.
Sign at the bottom and paste a latest passport size photograph at the top right.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of the certificates listed under Documents Required, and a self-addressed envelope with a postage stamp for information about the interview.
Write the name of the post applied for and the name of the programme in big letters on the envelope.
Send the application by registered post to the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Baghpat so that it reaches by 05:00 PM on 3 December 2026.
A separate application must be sent for each post if you apply for more than one.

Applicants will go through a Document Verification Process (DVP) and an interview. The dates of the DVP and the interview will be informed separately. Candidates must attend with a latest biodata, all required records, registration, two latest colour photographs and 01 set of self-attested copies of the required certificates. No travelling allowance of any kind will be paid for the interview.

content_sections.heading: About CMO Baghpat
content_sections.text: The Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Baghpat is the district health office of Baghpat district in Uttar Pradesh. This recruitment follows letter no. 179/एस.पी.एम.यू./एन.एच.एम./डी0डब्ल्यू/2026-27/3452 dated 15.09.2026 of the Mission Director, National Health Mission, Uttar Pradesh. The 23 posts are those that remained vacant after a walk-in interview held earlier for Medical Officer (MBBS) under the various NHM programmes run in the district.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 23 vacancies across nine programmes, with the facility of posting and the category-wise reservation roster for each. The figures below are copied from the notice and add up to 23 (SC 12, UR 8, OBC 3). Selection will follow the reservation policy in force of the Uttar Pradesh Government. The number of posts may decrease or increase, and may change at any stage of the recruitment process; if it does, reservation will apply according to the Government Order and category table.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice prints the same qualification and experience for all nine programmes, including the Female Medical Officer (MBBS) posts under Maternal Health. The two Maternal Health posts at F.R.U. (CHC) Baghpat and Khekra are for female candidates, as the post is named Female Medical Officer (MBBS). Candidates should check the official notification for the programme-wise eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice gives the approved honorarium against each vacancy in rupees per month: The posts are purely on honorarium under contract terms, and no claim to permanency will be accepted. Appointment will be valid up to one financial year and will be subject to the guidelines issued by the Mission Director, National Health Mission, Uttar Pradesh. If any adverse fact is found, the District Health Society / National Health Mission, Uttar Pradesh will have the right to end the selected candidate's contract or service by giving one month's notice or an amount equal to one month's pay in lieu of notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CMO Baghpat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 23 contractual posts: 21 Medical Officer (MBBS) posts in eight programmes and 2 Female Medical Officer (MBBS) posts under Maternal Health.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CMO Baghpat Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Baghpat by registered post by 05:00 PM on 3 December 2026; later applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Medical Officer (MBBS) posts?
faq.answer: An MBBS Degree from a recognized Institution with MCI Registration / UP Medical Council Registration, and at least 01 year of working experience in a recognized hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CMO Baghpat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The candidate's age must not be more than 62 years on the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Medical Officer under CMO Baghpat?
faq.answer: The pay is 100000/- per month for SNCU, CHC NCD Clinic, Blood Bank, Maternal Health, DHS and DHS IPHS, and 80000 Basic + 20000 PBI for 15th Finance, PM ABHIM and NUHM.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CMO Baghpat Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: Send a signed application with photograph and self-attested certificates only by registered post to the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Baghpat, with the post and programme name written in big letters on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Document Verification Process (DVP) and an interview, whose dates will be informed separately.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CMO Baghpat Medical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on honorarium under contract terms, valid up to one financial year, and no claim to permanency will be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one programme?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application must be sent for each post.

faq.question: Q10. Will travelling allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no travelling allowance of any kind will be paid for the interview.
